entry.name: xmPath
entry.label: Command to run
entry.whatsthis: Full path of the xm command. Leave empty to use ~/.local/bin/xm.

entry.name: pollInterval
entry.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
entry.whatsthis: How often the applet asks xm for the current profile. A lower number keeps the panel icon more accurate but costs a little CPU. xm answers in about 15 milliseconds, so 2 seconds is already plenty.

entry.name: showText
entry.label: Show the current profile and result messages in the popup
entry.whatsthis: Turn off for a compact popup with just the buttons.

entry.name: confirmReset
entry.label: Ask before restoring audio defaults
entry.whatsthis: Show a confirmation before the "Restore audio defaults" button runs. Keep this on: that is the one action here that changes your WirePlumber setup.

entry.name: notifications
entry.label: Show a notification when an action finishes
entry.whatsthis: Useful for the slow actions (reset, fix) that you start and then look away from. Turn off for a completely silent applet.
